_doc: Every machine Altention manages: how to reach it and what it is for. Change this file, commit it, then run `python3 ops/apply.py <machine>` from the bot machine.

notes: Runs the Discord bot. Always on.
GPU server. Conversations started here in tmux can be attached to Discord with /attach.
macOS laptop; sleeps when closed, so its scheduled jobs catch up when it wakes.
